# GitHub Copilot Coding Assistant Instructions

This project uses a centralized agent contract. Follow these in order of priority:

1. **[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)** — Stack, rules, and coding constraints
2. **[docs/architecture.md](../docs/architecture.md)** — Architectural blueprint and diagrams
3. **[.agents/rules/](../.agents/rules/)** — Topic rules (web, security, backend, graphify)
4. **[.agents/rules/github_issue.md](../.agents/rules/github_issue.md)** — Autonomous implementation workflow (issue → branch → PR against `develop`)
